# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 CH3COOH 0.001mol
new
add v2 water 100mL
add v2 CH3COOH 0.001mol
titrate v1 NaOH 0.01M 0.1mL until ph 7 max 1200
titrate v2 NaOH 0.01M 0.1mL until ph 8.7 max 1200
inspect
